scientific_integrity: The derivation is analytic and self-contained; numerical examples are sanity checks, not proof. The spectral-edge expansion is conditional on its stated mass law.
scientific_limitations: Population stationary independent-mode model; finite nuisance first moment; regular edge mass needed for logarithmic refinement. No sample-level or nonlinear tipping inference.
title: Single-reversal sampling boundary and spectral-edge law for hidden critical autocorrelation
